editorial:
Imagine leaving your tiny hometown in Italy and moving halfway across the world to Missouri just to chase a wild dream. That is exactly what Monica and Karim do in this documentary. You get to follow this couple as they dive headfirst into the world of American professional wrestling. They aren't just partners in their personal lives; they are a team in the ring too. The movie feels very grounded and real, showing you the grit and sweat it takes to go from a small academy to the big stages of the WWE and NWA. It is a sweet but tough look at how much they are willing to sacrifice for their passion.

What really makes this work is the raw energy of the indie wrestling circuit. You see the long drives and the hard hits, which makes their success feel earned. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you only care about the fights. If you love underdog stories or just want to see a couple fighting for their dreams, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see every detail of the matches, or grab the Blu-ray if you like owning physical copies of unique docs.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing the couple balancing their love for each other with the brutal demands of the wrestling business. You see them continuing to travel and compete, proving that their bond is stronger than the physical toll of the sport. There is no shocking twist, but the conclusion leaves you feeling inspired. It ends with them embracing their identity as international wrestlers who finally found their place in the American ring.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and professional wrestling.
